part_types.label: Validator
part_types.description: A test, audit, or validator that checks a contract, generated output, workflow, or safety boundary.

part_types.label: Contract
part_types.description: A schema, ontology, taxonomy, or structured interface that constrains records or graph meaning.

part_types.label: Gate
part_types.description: A CI, hook, policy, or approval check that blocks unsafe promotion, mutation, or release.

part_types.label: Runner
part_types.description: A command, script, task file, or orchestration entrypoint that runs workflow steps.

part_types.label: Orchestrator
part_types.description: A runbook or workflow controller that orders multiple parts without being the only authority.

part_types.label: Prompt Part
part_types.description: A prompt, instruction, front-door, or agent-facing text component.

part_types.label: Capability Provider
part_types.description: An agent, skill, adapter, script, or registry entry that provides a reusable capability.

part_types.label: Human Gate
part_types.description: A review packet, approval path, or evidence gate requiring human judgment before promotion.

part_types.label: Evaluation Gold Set
part_types.description: Gold, expected, fixture, benchmark, or review examples used to evaluate behavior.

part_types.label: Learning Signal
part_types.description: A failure, exception, feedback, postflight, handoff, or lesson cue that can improve future work.

part_types.label: Boundary Map
part_types.description: A source-authority, privacy, security, public-safe, or cross-repo boundary surface.
deterministic_v1_signals: authority, privacy, security, or source-boundary language

part_types.label: Decision Record
part_types.description: An ADR, roadmap evidence file, gate evidence file, or decision log that records why a path was chosen.

part_types.label: Lesson Part
part_types.description: A reusable lesson, deterministic rule, or pay-forward note with applicability limits.

part_types.label: Calibration Gate
part_types.description: A label, threshold, score, false-positive, false-negative, or measured review step.

part_types.label: Quarantine Gate
part_types.description: A scanner, exclusion, quarantine, secret, or unsafe-input control that keeps risky material out of default use.

rule: Workflow part records are generated candidates. They store role and metadata only, never private row content or source-repository authority claims.
